title: Chemical extraction of sulfachloropyridazine from liver samples
author: Ekaterina Pokrant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pwxdpfn
materials: Sodium hydroxide Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1064981000
Hydrochloric acid fuming 37% Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1003172500
Mobile phase A: 0.1% formic acid in methanol (pH 2.9 ± 0.3)

steps.title: Incubate sample 15 min
steps.instruction: Allow the sample to stand for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate sample 10 min
steps.instruction: Allow the sample to stand for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add sodium hydroxide
steps.instruction: Add sodium hydroxide (Merck Millipore, catalog #1064981000) to the sample.

steps.title: Incubate mixture 15 min
steps.instruction: Let the mixture stand for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate mixture 5 min
steps.instruction: Let the mixture stand for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add 37% hydrochloric acid
steps.instruction: Add 37% fuming hydrochloric acid (Merck Millipore, catalog #1003172500) to the mixture.

steps.title: Add ethyl acetate
steps.instruction: Add ethyl acetate (J.T. Baker, catalog #9280-03) to the mixture.

steps.title: Incubate mixture 10 min
steps.instruction: Let the mixture stand for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate mixture 2 min
steps.instruction: Let the mixture stand for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate mixture 10 min
steps.instruction: Let the mixture stand for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add ethyl acetate again
steps.instruction: Add a second portion of ethyl acetate (J.T. Baker, catalog #9280-03).

steps.title: Prepare mobile phase A
steps.instruction: Prepare mobile phase A consisting of 0.1% formic acid in methanol (pH 2.9 ± 0.3) using methanol (J.T. Baker, catalog #9093-03) and formic acid (98‑100%, Merck Millipore, catalog #100264).

steps.title: Prepare mobile phase B
steps.instruction: Prepare mobile phase B consisting of 0.1% formic acid in water (pH 2.7 ± 0.2) using water (Merck Millipore, catalog #1153334000).

steps.title: Incubate after mobile phases 5 min
steps.instruction: Allow the system to stand for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate after mobile phases 5 min
steps.instruction: Allow the system to stand for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate after mobile phases 10 min
steps.instruction: Allow the system to stand for 10 minutes.
